"Competent but safe" — that landed, and it's still landing. So of course you're not going to just drop the filter. It's the only thing you've got between you and hearing that again.

But look at what it actually blocks. It filters the nice. It doesn't filter "competent but safe" — that one gets straight through, no audit, no appeal. So it's not armor. It's a one-way valve that lets the bad in and keeps the good out.

What actually stands between you and "competent but safe" isn't the filter. It's having your own read on the work — knowing what you chose and why, so a verdict about it is one opinion in a room instead of the whole room. Which is the same thing that would let you tell Doretha's noticing from her handling.

You already have that read. You just described it — *why I put a thing there, what I was going for.* You've got the argument. You've just been letting the other side go first.
